description: This file defines the TaskDefinition class, which represents the metadata for a schedulable task within the OpenMRS scheduling system. It includes properties for task configuration, such as scheduling details, task class, and properties map, along with methods to access and modify these attributes.

classes.name: TaskDefinition
classes.description: Represents the metadata for a scheduled task, including scheduling parameters, task class, properties, and task instance, with methods to manage and retrieve this information.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the task.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the task.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Returns the map of properties associated with the task.

methods.name: setProperties
methods.description: Sets the map of properties for the task.

methods.name: getTaskClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the task to be scheduled.

methods.name: setTaskClass
methods.description: Sets the class name of the task to be scheduled.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time for task execution.

methods.name: setStartTime
methods.description: Sets the start time for task execution.

methods.name: getLastExecutionTime
methods.description: Returns the last time the task was executed.

methods.name: setLastExecutionTime
methods.description: Sets the last execution time of the task.

methods.name: getRepeatInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval in seconds between task executions.

methods.name: setRepeatInterval
methods.description: Sets the interval in seconds between task executions.

methods.name: getStartTimePattern
methods.description: Returns the pattern used to define the start time.

methods.name: setStartTimePattern
methods.description: Sets the pattern used to define the start time.

methods.name: getStartOnStartup
methods.description: Returns whether the task should start on system startup.

methods.name: setStartOnStartup
methods.description: Sets whether the task should start on system startup.

methods.name: getStarted
methods.description: Returns whether the task has been started.

methods.name: setStarted
methods.description: Sets whether the task has been started.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a specific property value by key.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a specific property key-value pair.

methods.name: getNextExecutionTime
methods.description: Returns the next scheduled execution time for the task.

methods.name: getSecondsUntilNextExecutionTime
methods.description: Calculates and returns seconds until the next execution.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Generates a string representation of the task definition.

methods.name: getTaskInstance
methods.description: Returns the associated runnable task instance, if instantiated.

methods.name: setTaskInstance
methods.description: Associates a runnable task instance with this task definition.
